description: Compose and send one outgoing email from the configured mailbox. From is the profile's own EMAIL_ADDRESS with no draft step, so use deliberately. Plain-text body plus optional CC/BCC and local file attachments; reply_to_message_id threads a reply to a message you read.
name: email_send

attachments.description: Local file paths to attach; missing paths are skipped and reported.

bcc.description: BCC address(es), comma-separated; added in the SMTP envelope without a visible header.

reply_to_message_id.description: Message-ID of the mail being replied to; sets In-Reply-To/References threading.

save_to_sent.description: Copy the message into the sent folder server-side (folder names differ; failures are reported).

sent_folder.description: Folder used when save_to_sent is true (default Sent).

subject.description: Subject line; empty sends a subject-less mail.
